article.story: BALTIMORE -- — Jah'likai King's 24 points helped UMBC defeat Vermont 75-62 on Thursday. King also added five rebounds for the Retrievers (17-8, 10-2 America East Conference). Anthony Valentine added 12 points and five assists. Caden Diggs shot 3 of 8 from the field, including 2 for 5 from 3-point range, and went 4 for 4 from the line to finish with 12 points. TJ Long led the way for the Catamounts (17-11, 9-4) with 21 points and eight rebounds. Vermont also got 17 points, 12 rebounds and two steals from Gus Yalden, and Momo Nkugwa finished with seven points and two steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
